datasets.title: The Philippines schools mapping by OpenStreetMap
datasets.description: This project is a portmanteau of OSM + Map + Paaralan - to collaboratively map public schools (paaralan) in the Philippines, on OpenStreetMap. Documentation available at https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Philippines/OSMaPaaralan. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/schools-mapping-in-the-philippines-by-openstreetmap]

entity.name: Department of Education, CY 2012 Public Schools Masterlist

lineage.description: Public school location data from the Philippine Department of Education (2012) was extracted and validated through visual inspection against available satellite imagery by OpenStreetMap contributors, then compiled into a cleaned geographic dataset of school facilities across the Philippines.

sources.name: Department of Education, CY 2012 Public Schools Masterlist
sources.description: Administrative registry of public schools in the Philippines with location data, validated and georeferenced through OpenStreetMap collaborative mapping

resources.title: Schools dataset cleaned and reviewed
resources.description: These data files is the cleaned version of the original data set received from DepEd, back in 2013. You can find the JSON version at https://github.com/OSMPH/deped_schools_db/tree/master/data/2019

asset_type.description: Public school facilities mapped with geographic coordinates and validated through imagery
